label: Claude Code
prereq: Python project with pytest, git, and uv
initNote: Run this command in your project root directory. Guard builds the FalkorDB test graph for your repository.
restart: Restart Claude Code in your project directory.

  freshness     PASS   Graph is fresh at commit 822d265

writes.description: Sets the stop hook to run 'guard hook stop' with exit code 2 on failure
Adds instructions that require tests before task completion
Adds .guard/ to ignore local database files
Stores the local graph and test session cache

coverageNote: The --yes option installs pytest-cov if pytest-cov is not installed in your environment.
platformLimit: System requirements: Embedded FalkorDB requires Python 3.12+, Linux glibc 2.39+, or macOS 15+. On other systems, Guard uses Docker automatically.
alternative: Optional: Install Guard with pipx (pipx install guard-cli).
